Name: Secretariat (Faster Horse)
Author: Janglinator
Description:
Secretariat gives your horse [b]+3 speed by default[/b]. The bonus kicks in when you mount and ends when you dismount. Coffee, food, carrots, and the Horse book still contribute their usual bonuses.

[b]Install or update[/b]
1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] for Stardew Valley 1.6.
2. Extract the Secretariat folder from the download into Stardew Valley/Mods. If you’re updating, keep your existing config.json.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI and hop on your horse.

[b]Change the speed boost[/b]
Launch the game through SMAPI once, then quit. Open [b]Mods/Secretariat/config.json[/b] in a text editor. Set [b]SpeedBoost[/b] to a whole number, save the file, and relaunch through SMAPI. For example, this gives you a faster ride:
[code]{ "SpeedBoost": 5 }[/code]Use 1 for a gentler ride, 3 for the default, or 0 for vanilla horse speed.

[b]Multiplayer and other mods[/b]
Install Secretariat on each computer whose riders want the bonus. Split-screen riders share one setting and can mount or dismount independently. Secretariat applies its own hidden speed buff, so other speed buffs and slime slowdowns keep working. Tested with a host and farmhand on Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2.

[b]Credits[/b]
Original mod by Jangles (Janglinator). OpenAI Codex wrote the 1.2.0 compatibility update and prepared this page. The cover is an OpenAI ImageGen illustration. The spring riding screenshot is from the game. [url=https://github.com/Janglinator/Secretariat]Source code and history[/url].
